normalization.seed: valkey_benchmark.random.randint patched to a deterministic counter (1, 2, 3, ...) per capture; each --seed token in argv is the ordinal of that draw
normalization.cwd: pathlib.Path.cwd() patched to /golden-cwd (affects test_groups dataset paths)
normalization.identity: commit_id=golden-commit, architecture=golden-arch, repository=None, valkey_benchmark_path defaults to src/valkey-benchmark
normalization.csv: canned valkey-benchmark CSV: rps=100000.00 avg=0.500 min=0.100 p50=0.400 p95=0.800 p99=1.200 max=2.000; row test name = token after -t (simple format) or SCENARIO (test_groups format)
normalization.environment_metadata: valkey_benchmark.collect_environment_metadata patched (whole-function replacement, at the ClientRunner lookup site) to return a fixed dict {'kernel_version': 'golden-kernel', 'os': 'golden-os', 'cpu_model': 'golden-cpu', 'cpu_governor': 'golden-governor', 'turbo_boost': 'golden-turbo', 'idle_states': 'golden-idle', 'aslr': 'golden-aslr', 'thp': 'golden-thp', 'numa_nodes': '1'}. environment_metadata's real implementation shells out (lscpu, sysfs) via subprocess.run, whose internal Popen this harness records; replacing the function keeps those host probes out of argv and makes the flattened env_* metric fields deterministic. cpu_freq_mhz_at_setup (a live reading) is intentionally omitted.
